name: Bridge Lighten
steps: Cat: Tap orange cat → shoo it away.
Blue Shirt Man Toast: Tap his hands → drops giant toast.
Blonde Woman Hair: Tap her → remove long extensions.
Blonde Woman Bag: Tap again → drop designer handbag.
Floral Dress Jacket: Tap left girl → remove trench coat.
Floral Dress Shoes: Tap feet → remove gold shoes.
Blue Shirt Man Snacks: Tap again → drop backpack of snacks.
Central Man Water Weight: Tap man → reduce water weight.
Central Man Gold Watch: Tap wrist → watch falls into gorge.
